<style>

/* ─── Reset & Tokens ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

:root {
  --lime:       #a3d01d;
  --lime-dark:  #8ab518;
  --dark:       #100828;
  --dark-card:  #1a0f38;
  --white:      #ffffff;
  --off-white:  #f8f8f4;
  --mid-grey:   #4a4566;
  --light-grey: #e8e5f0;
  --danger:     #d97706;
  --danger-bg:  #fef3c7;
  --shadow-sm:  0 2px 12px rgba(16,8,40,0.10);
  --shadow-md:  0 6px 32px rgba(16,8,40,0.14);
  --shadow-lg:  0 16px 64px rgba(16,8,40,0.20);
  --radius:     8px;
  --radius-lg:  16px;
}

html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

body {
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  background: var(--off-white);
  color: #1a1a2e;
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

/* ─── Typography helpers ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.orbitron { font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif; }
.cabin    { font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif; }

/* ─── Animations ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@keyframes fadeUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(28px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}
@keyframes slideRight {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-20px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
}
@keyframes pulseGlow {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(163,208,29,0); }
  50%       { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(163,208,29,0.15); }
}
@keyframes gridShimmer {
  0%   { opacity: 0.04; }
  50%  { opacity: 0.09; }
  100% { opacity: 0.04; }
}

.anim-fade-up   { animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease both; }
.anim-fade-in   { animation: fadeIn 0.6s ease both; }
.anim-slide-r   { animation: slideRight 0.6s ease both; }

/* Scroll-reveal — JS-free: uses :has() + CSS counter trick via Intersection Observer polyfill */
.reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(24px);
  transition: opacity 0.65s ease, transform 0.65s ease;
}
.reveal.visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* ─── Layout ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.container {
  max-width: 1120px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 24px;
}
.container--narrow {
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 24px;
}

/* ─── Sticky Nav ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
nav {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  background: var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--lime);
  height: 60px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}
.nav-inner {
  max-width: 1120px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 24px;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.nav-brand {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--white);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.nav-links {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 28px;
}
.nav-links a {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 0.2s;
}
.nav-links a:hover { color: var(--white); }
.btn-nav {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  background: var(--lime);
  color: var(--dark);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 9px 18px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.btn-nav:hover { background: var(--lime-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }

/* ─── CTA Buttons ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.btn-primary {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  background: var(--lime);
  color: var(--dark);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 18px 38px;
  font-size: 15px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  animation: pulseGlow 3s ease infinite;
}
.btn-primary:hover {
  background: var(--lime-dark);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(163,208,29,0.30);
}
.btn-primary--sm {
  padding: 13px 28px;
  font-size: 13px;
}

/* ─── Labels / Pills ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.label {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--lime);
  background: rgba(163,208,29,0.10);
  border: 1px solid rgba(163,208,29,0.30);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.label--dark {
  color: var(--dark);
  background: rgba(163,208,29,0.15);
  border-color: rgba(163,208,29,0.40);
}

/* ─── Placeholder warning ────────────────────────────────────── */
.placeholder-warning {
  background: var(--danger-bg);
  border: 2px solid var(--danger);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  color: #92400e;
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.placeholder-warning::before { content: "⚠"; font-size: 16px; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   HERO
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero {
  background: var(--dark);
  padding: 120px 0 100px;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Geometric grid overlay */
.hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(163,208,29,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(163,208,29,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 48px 48px;
  animation: gridShimmer 6s ease infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Radial vignette over grid */
.hero::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 70% at 50% 40%, transparent 30%, var(--dark) 80%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero__inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.hero__badge {
  animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease 0.1s both;
}

.hero__headline {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 5vw, 3.4rem);
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--white);
  max-width: 660px;
  margin: 0 auto 12px;
  line-height: 1.15;
  animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease 0.2s both;
}

.hero__subhead {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--lime);
  max-width: 660px;
  margin: 0 auto 24px;
  line-height: 1.2;
  animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease 0.35s both;
}

.hero__body {
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.80);
  max-width: 540px;
  margin: 0 auto 40px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease 0.5s both;
}

.hero__cta {
  animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease 0.65s both;
}

.hero__guarantee-note {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 14px;
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  animation: fadeIn 0.6s ease 0.85s both;
}

/* Stats row */
.hero__stats {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0;
  margin-top: 68px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(163,208,29,0.18);
  padding-top: 48px;
  animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease 1.0s both;
}

.hero__stat {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 140px;
  max-width: 200px;
  padding: 0 28px;
  position: relative;
}
.hero__stat + .hero__stat::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 15%;
  height: 70%;
  width: 1px;
  background: rgba(163,208,29,0.25);
}

.stat-value {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--lime);
  display: block;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.stat-label {
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.50);
  line-height: 1.4;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PROBLEM SECTION
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.problem {
  background: var(--white);
  padding: 100px 0;
  text-align: center;
}

.problem__headline {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3.5vw, 2.4rem);
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--dark);
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto 10px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.problem__subhead {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--mid-grey);
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.problem__body {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: var(--mid-grey);
  max-width: 660px;
  margin: 0 auto 60px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

/* Search engine comparison visual */
.search-compare {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 24px;
  max-width: 820px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: left;
}

.search-mock {
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.search-mock__header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.10em;
}

.search-mock--google .search-mock__header {
  background: #1e293b;
  color: #93c5fd;
}
.search-mock--amazon .search-mock__header {
  background: #1c0505;
  color: #fca5a5;
}

.search-mock__dot {
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-block;
}
.search-mock--google .search-mock__dot { background: #3b82f6; }
.search-mock--amazon .search-mock__dot { background: #ef4444; }

.search-mock__body {
  background: #0f172a;
  padding: 16px;
}

.search-bar {
  background: #1e293b;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.60);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.search-bar::before { content: "🔍"; font-size: 12px; }

.search-result {
  background: #1e293b;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
}
.search-result__brand {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.search-result__url {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.search-result__snippet {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* Google — brand appears */
.search-mock--google .search-result__brand { color: #86efac; }
.found-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  background: rgba(134,239,172,0.15);
  color: #86efac;
  border: 1px solid rgba(134,239,172,0.35);
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  margin-left: 8px;
}

/* Amazon — brand absent */
.search-mock--amazon .search-result {
  opacity: 0.35;
  filter: grayscale(0.5);
}
.search-mock--amazon .search-result__brand { color: #fca5a5; }
.absent-overlay {
  position: relative;
  background: rgba(239,68,68,0.08);
  border: 1px dashed rgba(239,68,68,0.35);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.absent-overlay .absent-text {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: rgba(239,68,68,0.75);
  letter-spacing: 0.10em;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ANCHOR PRICING SECTION
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.anchor {
  background: var(--dark);
  padding: 100px 0;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.anchor::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(163,208,29,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(163,208,29,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 64px 64px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.anchor__inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 48px;
  align-items: start;
}

.anchor__header {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.anchor__headline {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--white);
  line-height: 1.15;
  max-width: 700px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Cost table */
.cost-table-card {
  background: var(--dark-card);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  border: 1px solid rgba(163,208,29,0.12);
}

.cost-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}
.cost-table thead tr {
  background: var(--lime);
}
.cost-table thead th {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.10em;
  color: var(--dark);
  text-align: left;
  padding: 14px 20px;
}
.cost-table tbody tr {
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  transition: background 0.15s;
}
.cost-table tbody tr:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
}
.cost-table tbody td {
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  padding: 14px 20px;
  vertical-align: middle;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.cost-table tbody td:last-child {
  text-align: right;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.60);
}
.cost-table tfoot tr {
  background: rgba(163,208,29,0.12);
  border-top: 2px solid var(--lime);
}
.cost-table tfoot td {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--lime);
  padding: 16px 20px;
}
.cost-table tfoot td:last-child {
  text-align: right;
  font-size: 15px;
}

/* Right panel */
.anchor__right {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 40px 32px;
  background: var(--dark-card);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  border: 1px solid rgba(163,208,29,0.18);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.anchor__price {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 5.5rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--lime);
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  text-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(163,208,29,0.25);
}

.anchor__price-label {
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.70);
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PROCESS SECTION
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.process {
  background: var(--off-white);
  padding: 100px 0;
  text-align: center;
}

.process__headline {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.1rem);
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--dark);
  max-width: 700px;
  margin: 0 auto 56px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.phases {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 0;
  max-width: 1060px;
  margin: 0 auto 48px;
  position: relative;
}

/* Connector line between cards */
.phases::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 36px;
  left: calc(33.33% - 1px);
  right: calc(33.33% - 1px);
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lime), rgba(163,208,29,0.30));
  z-index: 1;
}

.phase-card {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 32px 28px;
  margin: 0 10px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  text-align: left;
  transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.phase-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.phase-card--launch  { border-left: 4px solid #22c55e; }
.phase-card--grow    { border-left: 4px solid #3b82f6; }
.phase-card--compound { border-left: 4px solid var(--lime); }

.phase-card__num {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: rgba(16,8,40,0.35);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.phase-card__title {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--dark);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.phase-card__period {
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--mid-grey);
  font-style: italic;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.phase-card__body {
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--mid-grey);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.process__footnote {
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--mid-grey);
  max-width: 680px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  line-height: 1.70;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GUARANTEE SECTION
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.guarantee {
  background: var(--dark);
  padding: 100px 0;
  text-align: center;
  border-top: 2px solid rgba(163,208,29,0.30);
  border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(163,208,29,0.30);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.guarantee::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 60% at 50% 50%, rgba(163,208,29,0.05) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.guarantee__inner { position: relative; z-index: 2; }

.guarantee__quote {
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--white);
  max-width: 780px;
  margin: 0 auto 28px;
  line-height: 1.70;
  position: relative;
  padding: 0 40px;
}
.guarantee__quote::before {
  content: '\201C';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: -12px;
  font-size: 5rem;
  color: rgba(163,208,29,0.25);
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  line-height: 1;
}
.guarantee__quote::after {
  content: '\201D';
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -36px;
  font-size: 5rem;
  color: rgba(163,208,29,0.25);
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  line-height: 1;
}

.guarantee__sub {
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
  max-width: 620px;
  margin: 48px auto 40px;
  line-height: 1.70;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PROOF / SOCIAL PROOF SECTION
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.proof {
  background: var(--white);
  padding: 100px 0;
  text-align: center;
}

.proof__headline {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
